utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive, but only second-hand. Is Mina the one coordinating it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure, but I think Mina’s coordinating it. I can ask around about what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds right. Let me know what you hear about what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Opal. Tell me where you need me and what I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can ask around and see who’s free to help with the repair drive. Sam already said he can help, and I’ll check with Jules too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Opal. I’m ready to help once you know where I’m needed, and I can bring whatever’s most useful.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Noah. Take the drill and clamps if that’s the right fit, and I’ll be here if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, I’ll take the drill and clamps then. Thanks, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Noah. Take good care of them, and let me know if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m in, Vik. Let’s figure out what still needs fixing and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep moving down the list and make sure the others know what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Vik. I’m ready to help with whatever’s left on the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, Rosa — send me the updated list and I’ll fold in any last-minute fixes for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What’s still left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly the smaller fixes are left now; send me the updated list and I’ll keep it tight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Mara says she can help with the repair drive. Just tell her where you need her and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I can swing by later and see what still needs doing. Just point me to where Mara should start and what she should bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll have Mara start where you point her and bring whatever tools you think fit the first pass.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. Send me the notes and I’ll help with the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good to hear, but I hope the notes are organized before people start showing up. Repairs go smoother when the schedule's clear.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll make sure the notes are organized before anyone arrives.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve heard the repair drive is happening, and I can ask around to see who’s free to help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what needs to be repaired on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m not sure yet, but I can ask around and get the latest on what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Rey. Send me the repair list and I’ll fold it into the drive plan right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks. I’ll send over the repair list so you can fold it into the plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Rey. Once it’s in, I’ll update the plan and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive's getting a good bit of help today. Folks around here do show up when it counts.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can stop by for a bit. Just tell me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That'd be a real help, Uli. Swing by the hall anytime this afternoon and ask for Mara; she'll put you to work where it's needed most.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It starts at 9 o'clock, so I'll have everything ready by then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll be there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve still got a few things to patch up, but the biggest one is the broken fence panel. I can take care of the rest after that.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll handle the fence panel.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Mara said she can help with the repair drive too. Just tell her where you need her and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What’s still left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We still need hands, tools, and whatever parts are missing from the list. Mara’s available too, so just tell me where to send her.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard it’s moving along. I can swing by later and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m on it too. I’ll tell the others and we can sort out what’s left when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, I’ll come by later and help sort out what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d help a lot, Gus. I’ll get the drive set up and use the drill and clamps carefully.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good. I can help once the setup's ready - what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just the loose brackets and the hinge need fixing now. Once I’ve got the drill and clamps on it, your help will be enough.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me exactly what needs to be repaired on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s mostly the driveway itself — the surface is cracked and the edge near the garage needs fixing. I can still cover the school runs if you can help with drop-off and pick-up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I can handle the driveway repair if you keep doing the school runs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I only got that second-hand. Is Mina the one organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure, but I can check with Mina if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, if you can check with Mina, that’d help. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve got it. I’ll ask around and see who’s free to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Right, I can help with that too if you need a list of what’s still broken.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Dane. I’ll start by asking around and I can fold your broken-item list into it too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I heard about that, but I might’ve missed the latest change.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I heard they’re getting a fair bit of help today, though I’d still check the timing before heading over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I’ll check the timing before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got Sam down as available to help with the repair drive, and I can still ask around for anyone else who’s free.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. I can help keep track if you need another set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep track of it and let Jules know I’m checking for more help too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can stop by for a bit. Just tell me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks. Start at the front porch, and I’ll show you the rest.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Okay, I’ll start at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, looks like folks are really turning out for it today. Good to see the neighborhood pull together like that.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah? What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think it starts around 10 this morning, give or take. Folks have already been drifting over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I can help with that. Just point me to what still needs fixing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m sending the list over now, and if you spot anything else, let me know so I can add it to the drive plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll keep an eye out for anything else that needs fixing and add it to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara. I can lend you my drill and a couple clamps to help get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus. I can bring myself and a plan, and I’ll come by to use the drill and clamps where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Mara. I’ll have the drill and clamps ready for you when you come by.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
